dataset.name: Bangladeshi Recipe Baseline 80
important_notes: Curated baseline for application seeding/testing; kitchen-test before claiming chef-verified accuracy.
Water is retained in recipe data but marked non-shoppable in the ingredient dictionary.
Ingredient identity and measurement dimension must remain separate; never merge weight, volume and count solely by ingredient identity.
Use numeric quantity and explicit unit directly for first-party seed data; do not parse display strings.

recipes.name: Steamed Rice
steps: Rinse rice until water is mostly clear.
Boil with measured water.
Cover and cook on low until tender; rest 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Sada Polao
steps: Wash and drain rice.
Fry onion and whole spices in ghee.
Add rice and fry briefly.
Add hot water, salt and sugar; cover and cook on low.

recipes.name: Bhuna Khichuri
steps: Dry-roast dal; wash with rice.
Fry onion, ginger, garlic and spices.
Bhuna rice and dal for several minutes.
Add hot water and salt; cook covered.
Finish with ghee, garam masala and green chili.

recipes.name: Moong Dal Khichuri
steps: Roast dal lightly and wash with rice.
Fry onion and ginger; add spices.
Add rice and dal, then water and salt.
Cook until soft; finish with ghee and chili.

recipes.name: Beef Tehari
steps: Marinate beef with yogurt, ginger, garlic and spices.
Brown onion in mustard oil; bhuna beef until nearly tender.
Add washed rice, green chili and hot water.
Cover and cook on low until rice and beef are done.

recipes.name: Morog Polao
steps: Marinate chicken.
Brown onion and whole spices in ghee; cook chicken until nearly done.
Fry drained rice briefly in the flavored fat.
Add water, milk, salt and sugar; place chicken on top and cook covered.
Finish with kewra if used.

recipes.name: Kacchi Biryani
steps: Marinate raw mutton with yogurt, aromatics, spices, oil and fried onion.
Parboil rice to about 70 percent and drain.
Brown potatoes lightly.
Layer mutton, potatoes, rice, milk, ghee and fried onion.
Seal and dum-cook on low until mutton is tender.
recipes.notes: Use a heavy-bottomed pot and gentle dum heat.

recipes.name: Chicken Biryani
steps: Marinate chicken.
Fry onion and cook chicken until nearly done.
Parboil rice.
Layer chicken, potato, rice, milk, ghee and chili; finish covered on low heat.

recipes.name: Vegetable Pulao
steps: Fry onion and whole spices in ghee.
Add vegetables and cook briefly.
Add rice and fry gently.
Add water, salt and sugar; cover and cook until tender.

recipes.name: Egg Khichuri
steps: Boil, peel and lightly fry eggs.
Roast dal; wash with rice.
Fry aromatics and spices; add rice and dal.
Add water and salt and cook until tender.
Add eggs and finish with ghee and green chili.

recipes.name: Bangladeshi Chicken Curry
steps: Lightly fry potatoes.
Brown onion; add ginger, garlic and spices.
Bhuna chicken well.
Add potatoes, water and salt; simmer until tender.
Finish with green chili and garam masala.

recipes.name: Chicken Roast
steps: Marinate chicken.
Fry onion until golden; reserve some.
Sear chicken with ghee, oil and whole spices.
Add milk and sugar and cook to a rich gravy.
Finish with kewra and fried onion if using.

recipes.name: Chicken Rezala
steps: Soften onion without deep browning.
Add ghee, whole spices, ginger, garlic and chicken.
Add beaten yogurt gradually.
Add water, salt and white pepper; simmer gently.
Finish with green chilies.

recipes.name: Chicken Korma
steps: Fry onion lightly in ghee.
Add whole spices, aromatics and chicken.
Add yogurt and cook until coated.
Add milk, sugar, salt and optional cashew paste; simmer until tender.

recipes.name: Chicken Bhuna
steps: Brown onion well.
Cook ginger, garlic and spices.
Add chicken and bhuna until deeply coated.
Add a little water and cook covered.
Uncover and reduce until gravy clings to the chicken.

recipes.name: Achari Chicken
steps: Temper whole pickling spices in mustard oil.
Add onion, ginger and garlic.
Add chicken, yogurt, powdered spices and salt.
Bhuna until oil separates and cook covered until tender.
Finish with green chili.

recipes.name: Chicken Jhal Fry
steps: Fry onion, ginger, garlic and green chili.
Add chicken, chili powder, pepper and salt.
Stir-fry until cooked and lightly browned.
Add soy sauce if using and reduce until nearly dry.

recipes.name: Chicken Curry with Potato
steps: Lightly fry potatoes.
Cook onion, aromatics and spices.
Bhuna chicken.
Add potatoes, water and salt; simmer until tender.
Finish with green chili.

recipes.name: Chicken Do Pyaza
steps: Slice half the onion finely and half into petals.
Cook fine onion, tomato, aromatics and spices.
Add chicken and cook until nearly tender.
Add onion petals and green chili; finish while petals remain distinct.

recipes.name: Chicken Liver Bhuna
steps: Clean and drain liver.
Cook onion, aromatics and spices.
Add liver and salt; cook over medium heat.
Reduce moisture and finish with green chili.

recipes.name: Beef Bhuna
steps: Brown onion.
Cook ginger, garlic and spices.
Add beef and bhuna thoroughly.
Add water and salt; cook until tender.
Reduce to thick gravy and finish with chili and garam masala.

recipes.name: Kala Bhuna
steps: Cook onion slowly until deeply browned.
Add aromatics and spices without burning.
Add beef and bhuna for an extended period until dark.
Add water gradually and cook until tender.
Finish nearly dry and glossy.

recipes.name: Beef Curry with Potato
steps: Lightly fry potatoes.
Cook onion, aromatics and spices.
Bhuna beef well.
Add water and cook until partly tender; add potatoes.
Finish when both are tender.

recipes.name: Beef Rezala
steps: Cook onion gently in ghee.
Add whole spices, aromatics and beef.
Add yogurt gradually.
Add water, salt and pepper; simmer until tender.
Finish with green chili.

recipes.name: Beef Korma
steps: Fry onion gently in ghee.
Add whole spices, aromatics and beef.
Add yogurt and cook until coated.
Cook until nearly tender, then add milk, sugar and optional cashew paste.
Simmer to a rich gravy.

recipes.name: Beef Keema
steps: Fry onion.
Cook tomato, aromatics and spices into masala.
Add mince and break apart thoroughly.
Cook until moisture reduces; finish with green chili.

recipes.name: Beef Aloo Keema
steps: Cook onion, tomato, aromatics and spices.
Add mince and brown.
Add potato, salt and water.
Cover until potato is tender; reduce and finish with green chili.

recipes.name: Mutton Curry
steps: Marinate mutton with yogurt, aromatics and spices.
Brown onion and bhuna mutton.
Add water and cook until partly tender.
Add potatoes and finish until tender.
Add green chili.

recipes.name: Mutton Rezala
steps: Soften onion in ghee.
Add whole spices, aromatics and mutton.
Add yogurt gradually and cook well.
Add water, salt and pepper; simmer until tender.
Finish with green chili.

recipes.name: Beef Nihari
steps: Brown onion; add aromatics, spices and beef.
Add water and simmer very slowly until beef is very tender.
Thicken lightly with flour slurry.
Simmer 15 minutes and finish with garam masala.

recipes.name: Shorshe Ilish
steps: Rub hilsa with turmeric and salt.
Mix mustard paste with water and part of the oil.
Cook fish covered with mustard mixture and green chili.
Finish with remaining mustard oil.

recipes.name: Bhapa Ilish
steps: Coat hilsa with mustard, optional coconut, turmeric, salt and oil.
Place in a covered heatproof dish with green chili.
Steam until just cooked through.

recipes.name: Ilish Jhol with Eggplant
steps: Lightly fry seasoned hilsa.
Fry eggplant.
Make a light turmeric-chili broth.
Add eggplant and fish; simmer gently and finish with green chili.

recipes.name: Rui Macher Jhol
steps: Lightly fry seasoned fish.
Fry potato, onion and tomato with spices.
Add water and cook potato nearly tender.
Add fish and simmer; finish with green chili.

recipes.name: Rui Kalia
steps: Lightly fry seasoned fish.
Cook onion, aromatics and spices.
Add yogurt gradually and cook to a rich masala.
Add water and fish; simmer gently and finish with garam masala.

recipes.name: Katla Kalia
steps: Lightly fry seasoned fish.
Cook onion, aromatics and spices.
Stir in yogurt until oil separates.
Add water and fish; simmer until gravy thickens.

recipes.name: Pabda Macher Jhol
steps: Season fish with turmeric and salt.
Cook onion, tomato and spices in mustard oil.
Add water and simmer.
Add fish gently; finish with green chili.

recipes.name: Tengra Macher Jhol
steps: Lightly fry fish.
Fry potatoes and onion with spices.
Add water and cook potato nearly tender.
Add fish and simmer; finish with green chili.

recipes.name: Koi Macher Jhol
steps: Season and lightly fry fish.
Cook potato, onion, ginger and spices.
Add water and cook potato nearly tender.
Add fish and simmer gently; finish with green chili.

recipes.name: Chingri Malai Curry
steps: Season and briefly fry prawns.
Cook onion and ginger.
Add coconut milk, chili, sugar and salt; simmer gently.
Add prawns just until done; finish with ghee and green chili.

recipes.name: Chingri Bhuna
steps: Cook onion, tomato, aromatics and spices to a thick masala.
Add seasoned prawns.
Cook until masala clings to prawns.
Finish with green chili.

recipes.name: Lau Chingri
steps: Briefly fry seasoned prawns.
Cook onion and spices.
Add bottle gourd and salt; cover until it releases moisture.
Add prawns and finish until tender.

recipes.name: Shutki Bhuna
steps: Rinse or soak dried fish as appropriate.
Fry onion and garlic.
Add tomato and spices; cook down.
Add dried fish and cook until coated and softened; finish with chili.

recipes.name: Boal Macher Jhol
steps: Lightly fry seasoned fish.
Cook onion, ginger, potato and spices.
Add water and cook potatoes nearly tender.
Add fish and simmer gently; finish with green chili.

recipes.name: Pangash Macher Jhol
steps: Lightly fry seasoned fish.
Cook onion, tomato, potato and spices.
Add water and cook potato nearly done.
Add fish and simmer gently; finish with green chili.

recipes.name: Masoor Dal
steps: Simmer dal with turmeric and water until soft.
Add salt and adjust consistency.
Fry onion, garlic and green chili in oil.
Pour tempering over dal and simmer briefly.

recipes.name: Moong Dal
steps: Dry-roast dal until fragrant, then wash.
Cook with turmeric and water until soft.
Temper oil with cumin, onion, garlic and chili.
Add tempering and salt; simmer briefly.

recipes.name: Cholar Dal
steps: Cook dal until tender but intact.
Temper ghee with whole spices, ginger and onion.
Add turmeric, salt, sugar and optional raisins.
Combine with dal and simmer.

recipes.name: Lau Diye Moong Dal
steps: Roast and wash dal.
Cook dal with bottle gourd, turmeric, water and salt.
Temper oil with cumin, onion and green chili.
Add tempering and simmer briefly.

recipes.name: Mixed Vegetable Labra
steps: Cut vegetables evenly.
Start firmer vegetables in mustard oil.
Add spices, salt and remaining vegetables.
Add water and cook until soft and slightly mashed together.

recipes.name: Aloo Phulkopi
steps: Lightly fry cauliflower and potato.
Cook onion, tomato, ginger and spices.
Add vegetables and salt.
Add water and cook covered until tender.

recipes.name: Begun Aloo Jhol
steps: Lightly fry eggplant and potato.
Cook onion and spices.
Add water and potatoes; simmer until nearly tender.
Add eggplant and green chili; finish gently.

recipes.name: Potol Aloo Curry
steps: Scrape pointed gourds and cut potatoes.
Lightly fry both.
Cook onion, tomato, ginger and spices.
Return vegetables, add water and salt, and cook until tender.

recipes.name: Lau Ghonto
steps: Cut bottle gourd small.
Temper oil with cumin and onion.
Add gourd, turmeric, salt and chili.
Cover and cook in its own moisture until soft and nearly dry.

recipes.name: Bandhakopi Bhaji
steps: Shred cabbage and cut potatoes.
Temper oil with cumin and onion.
Add potato, then cabbage, turmeric, salt and chili.
Cook covered then uncover to reduce moisture.

recipes.name: Kumra Bhaji
steps: Temper oil with nigella and onion.
Add pumpkin, turmeric, salt and chili.
Cook covered until tender.
Add a little sugar if desired.

recipes.name: Pepe Torkari
steps: Cube papaya and potato.
Cook onion and ginger with spices.
Add vegetables, salt and water.
Cover until tender; finish with green chili.

recipes.name: Kochur Loti Niramish
steps: Clean and cut taro stolons thoroughly.
Cook onion and garlic with spices in mustard oil.
Add taro and salt; cook covered until tender.
Stir in mustard paste and green chili; reduce moisture.

recipes.name: Lal Shak Bhaji
steps: Wash and chop greens.
Fry garlic, onion and green chili.
Add greens and salt.
Cook uncovered until wilted and excess moisture evaporates.

recipes.name: Jhinge Aloo Torkari
steps: Cut ridge gourd and potatoes.
Temper oil with cumin and onion.
Add vegetables, turmeric, salt and chili.
Add water and cook covered until tender.

recipes.name: Aloo Bhorta
steps: Boil and peel potatoes.
Mash while warm.
Mix with onion, chili, mustard oil, salt and optional coriander.

recipes.name: Begun Bhorta
steps: Roast eggplant until completely soft.
Peel and drain.
Mash with onion, chili, mustard oil, salt and optional coriander.

recipes.name: Tomato Bhorta
steps: Roast or pan-cook tomato, garlic and chili.
Mash the cooked mixture.
Mix with onion, mustard oil and salt.

recipes.name: Dal Bhorta
steps: Cook dal until very soft and nearly dry.
Fry garlic and dried chili lightly.
Mash with onion, mustard oil and salt.

recipes.name: Shutki Bhorta
steps: Cook or roast dried fish until softened.
Remove bones where needed.
Mash with onion, garlic, chili, mustard oil and salt.

recipes.name: Chingri Bhorta
steps: Cook prawns with garlic and chili.
Chop or mash prawns.
Mix with onion, mustard oil and salt.

recipes.name: Kacha Morich Bhorta
steps: Char or crush green chilies.
Mash with onion and salt.
Mix in mustard oil and optional coriander.

recipes.name: Dim Bhorta
steps: Hard-boil and peel eggs.
Mash roughly.
Mix with onion, green chili, mustard oil, salt and optional coriander.

recipes.name: Aloo Bhaji
steps: Cut potatoes into thin strips.
Fry onion and green chili.
Add potato, turmeric and salt.
Cook until tender and lightly crisp.

recipes.name: Begun Bhaji
steps: Slice eggplant evenly.
Coat with turmeric, chili and salt.
Pan-fry in mustard oil until browned and tender.

recipes.name: Paratha
steps: Make a soft dough and rest 20 minutes.
Divide, roll, fold with oil or ghee, and roll again.
Cook on a hot pan with a little oil until golden on both sides.

recipes.name: Luchi
steps: Make a firm smooth dough and rest 15 minutes.
Divide and roll into small discs.
Deep-fry until puffed and pale golden.

recipes.name: Singara
steps: Make a firm dough and rest it.
Cook potato, peas, onion, ginger, chili and spices into a dry filling.
Shape dough into cones, fill and seal.
Deep-fry on medium-low heat until crisp and golden.

recipes.name: Beguni
steps: Slice eggplant thinly.
Mix batter from besan, rice flour, spices, salt and water.
Dip slices and deep-fry until crisp and golden.

recipes.name: Piyaju
steps: Soak dal 2 to 3 hours and drain.
Coarsely grind with minimal water.
Mix with onion, chili, coriander and salt.
Shape and deep-fry until crisp.

recipes.name: Payesh
steps: Bring milk to a gentle boil and reduce slightly.
Add washed rice, cardamom and bay leaf; cook slowly until rice is soft.
Add sugar and cook until creamy.
Add optional raisins and cashews.

recipes.name: Firni
steps: Soak rice and grind to a coarse paste with a little milk.
Heat remaining milk gently.
Whisk in rice paste and cook until thick.
Add sugar and cardamom; finish with optional rose water and pistachio, then chill.

recipes.name: Shemai
steps: Roast vermicelli lightly in ghee.
Add hot milk and cook until softened.
Add sugar and cardamom.
Simmer to desired thickness and add optional raisins and cashews.

recipes.name: Suji Halwa
steps: Roast semolina in ghee until aromatic.
Heat water, milk, sugar and cardamom separately.
Add hot liquid to semolina while stirring.
Cook until thick; add optional raisins and cashews.

recipes.name: Zarda
steps: Parboil washed rice until just tender and drain.
Heat ghee with cardamom and cinnamon.
Add rice, sugar and optional food color with a little water.
Cook covered on low until syrup is absorbed; add optional nuts and raisins.
